newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - New York ADRs follow market higher.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - New York ADRs follow market higher.

text.p: Foreign shares mostly followed the surge of the New York post-election market on Wednesday, with some technology stocks standing out.
"The markets today are all looking quite strong and it looks as if they'll gather strength over the next few days," said one trader.

Among American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), Telefonica de Espana was up 1-1/4 to 62-1/8 and Israel's Teledata Communications Ltd rose two to 19-1/4 after it reported its third-quarter earnings per share increased.
Luxury goods maker LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton rose 1-5/8 to 49 after Goldman Sachs initiated coverage of its stock with a rating of outperform.
Unilever Plc shares fell 1-1/8 to 84-1/4 after Lehman Brothers trimmed its earnings estimate for the third quarter.
The Netherlands' Akzo Nobel NV fell 7/8 to 63-1/4 after the company said its third-quarter profits were flat.
